verdict.rationale: Wave's docs confirm bank feed auto-import, auto-merge, and categorization of transactions (wave-docs-1, wave-docs-5, wave-supp-bank-feeds), which implies some matching mechanism, but there is no explicit documentation of a reconciliation workflow surfacing matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions for review. Missing for 10: explicit reconciliation screen/report, unmatched transaction flagging, duplicate detection and resolution workflow, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific review process.
